name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
title: Bigbloc Construction Ltd - 540061 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Volumes up 40% in Q4 but EBITDA margin only 7.36% and FY26 net loss ~INR 9 crore; management says pricing pass-through is lagging raw-material costs up 5-15%, with utilisation at 78% in Q4 and no capex committed.

utilisation.quote: Average capacity utilization during the quarter improved to around 78%.

triggers.label: Utilisation 53% (Q1) → 78% (Q4)
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization has been steadily rising from 53% in Q1 to 78% in Q4

triggers.label: Raw material costs up 5-15%
triggers.quote: the costs have escalated by approximately anywhere between 5% to 15%

triggers.label: Cost pass-through started last quarter
triggers.quote: since last quarter, we have been able to pass on some increase in cost to the customer

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 volume ~20% up YoY
triggers.quote: we have been able to see almost 20 percent growth in volumes in Q1 FY27 as compared to Q1 FY26

guidance.quote: we are targeting a volume growth in the range of almost 10% to 20%
We expect a healthy 10 -14% increase in capacity utilization during FY27.
hopefully in this year, we should be returning to profits again

red_flags.label: Net loss ~INR 9 cr FY26 despite 26% revenue growth
red_flags.quote: At the PAT level, the company reported a net loss of around INR 9 crores.

red_flags.label: Margin guidance vague; recovery pinned on pass-through
red_flags.quote: hopefully, we will be able to pass on the further increase in cost to the customer

red_flags.label: Carbon credit monetisation claimed but no revenue
red_flags.quote: in FY26, there has been no contribution in revenues or profitability from the carbon credits at all.

evasions.quote: So, their selling price was almost similar as compared to Q3.
we will be coming up with the expansion plan for the same, hopefully, in the upcoming quarters.
